title: Per-chain multi-token sweep → Safe multisig + Zodiac Roles Modifier v2

current_defects.native_only: aa.rs:519 encodes sweepNativeCall only; contract also has sweep(token,to) (AllbrightExecutor.sol:342)
current_defects.first_chain_only: aa.rs:504-508 Chain::ALL.find(executor).next() — other chains' profit stranded
current_defects.raw_eoa_destination: config.rs:239 PROFIT_WALLET / data/profit_wallets.json registry — hot destinations
current_defects.no_ledger_writer: GAP-21 dependency: data/transfers.jsonl has no writer; last_swept advances on submission, not receipt

profit_token_derivation: relay.rs:379-381 refuses token_in outside stable_addr(chain) → routes only settle in the per-chain stable set; native dust also accrues. Sweep set = stable_addr(chain) ∪ native. Blast caveat: USDB is a rebasing token — sweep it, but consolidate promptly.

sweep_loop_spec.new_behavior: for each chain in cfg.active_chains where executor_address(c).is_some() && rpc present: (1) eth_call balanceOf per listed token + executor eth balance; (2) for each nonzero token → UserOp execute → sweep(token, CHAIN_SAFE); (3) nonzero native → sweepNative(CHAIN_SAFE); (4) batch as one Kernel op per chain if CALLTYPE_BATCH is permitted, else sequential ops (note GAP-31 nonce allocator); (5) poll user_op_outcome → on 'included' decode Swept(token,to,amount) logs from receipt → append data/transfers.jsonl {ts,chain,token,amount,to,tx,userop_hash,status} (GAP-21); advance last_swept only on confirmed receipt
sweep_loop_spec.dust_gate: skip tokens whose USD value < SWEEP_DUST_USD (~$1) to avoid sponsored-op spam
sweep_loop_spec.cadence: keep existing jitter model; evaluate each chain independently

destination_safe.design: ONE Safe address on every chain — SafeProxyFactory.createProxyWithNonce(singleton, initializer, saltNonce) is cross-chain deterministic (NOT createChainSpecificProxyWithNonce)
destination_safe.sources: github.com/safe-fndn/safe-singleton-factory README; safe-global/safe-contracts v1.4.1 CHANGELOG; docs.safe.global — re-verify via safe-deployments package at deploy time
destination_safe.config: threshold 2-of-3 Commander cold keys (recommend); SafeL2 singleton on L2s, Safe on L1-style chains — same proxy address either way

zodiac_roles_v2.mastercopy: 0xF2964CE6161ce0e75964Fe7927cE114cb0B283D5 (v2.1.1 — docs.zodiac.eco/developers/roles; SDK zodiac-roles-sdk v4 targets v2 contracts)
zodiac_roles_v2.topology: Roles mod instance per chain deployed as a MODULE on the chain Safe; owner=avatar=target=the Safe (constellation quickstart pattern)
zodiac_roles_v2.why: kernel CallPolicy pins sweep `to`=Safe (GAP-8); the Roles mod then governs ONWARD movement out of the Safe without full multisig ceremony — a compromised sweep/consolidation path cannot redirect funds because role conditions are checked on-chain per call

role_conveyor.member: <conveyor signer — Turnkey-scoped key, or the Kernel account itself>
permissions: scopeTarget(SWEEPER_ROLE, <each stable token addr>) → scopeFunction approve(spender) with spender ONE_OF [LIFI_DIAMOND 0x1231DEB6f5749EF6cE6943a275A1D3E7486F4EaE] + withinAllowance(USD budget)
scopeTarget(SWEEPER_ROLE, LIFI_DIAMOND) → scopeFunction on LI.FI call selectors, c.withinAllowance for value moved, ExecutionOptions.Send required for native legs
allowFunction(SWEEPER_ROLE, <each stable token>, transfer.selector, args[to] EQUAL TREASURY_SAFE, options=Send) — direct consolidation rail
setAllowance(key, balance, maxRefill, refill, period=86400, timestamp) — rolling daily USD budget (docs.zodiac.eco/developers/roles/permissions + quickstart-roles)
role_conveyor.exec_path: execTransactionWithRole(to, value, data, op, roleKey, shouldRevert) — member-signed; on-chain condition tree enforced
role_conveyor.revocation: Safe threshold tx → assignRoles(member, [role], [false]) or disableModule — instant, no key trust needed

preconditions: GAP-8 permission enabled (the 'to'-pin is what makes compromised-key sweeps non-redirectable)
Chain Safe deployed + Roles mod enabled + role assigned before AUTO mode
each executor's owner == Kernel account (already enforced by contract constructor)
rollback: PROFIT_TRANSFER_MODE=MANUAL reverts to current dormant behavior
Safe: disableModule(RolesMod) via threshold tx removes the conveyor path; funds stay in Safe
sweep 'to' can only change via Safe-threshold action on the Kernel permission (or root rotation) — no hot path

pure_rust: aa.rs/main.rs: per-chain sweep loop + per-token balance probes (balanceOf selector keccak256('balanceOf(address)')[..4] pattern already in relay.rs:244)
receipt decode of Swept events + transfers.jsonl writer (GAP-21 pairing)
optional CALLTYPE_BATCH packing for multi-call ops (verify CallPolicy mode coverage first)
commander_actions: deploy the same-address Safe on every active chain (SafeProxyFactory tx per chain — needs deployer gas or sponsored op via CREATE2_PROXY pattern already in aa.rs:462)
deploy Roles mod + configure role via Zodiac app/SDK (owner-signed Safe txs)
choose Safe owners/threshold; fund conveyor signer a small gas budget if it is an EOA
